proof_explanation: The repair implements total Boolean negation by returning '!value' instead of the constant 'false'. This satisfies the postcondition 'ensures result == !value' for all boolean inputs: when value=true, it returns false; when value=false, it returns true. The buggy implementation violated this law by always returning false, which fails to implement negation correctly as a total function across the boolean domain.

The implementation fails to implement negation as a total function across the boolean domain. The corrected implementation returns !value to satisfy the law for all boolean inputs.
